propositions: The outbound update differ compares in vendor (Jira) shape while the inbound differ diffs canonically, an asymmetry that keeps core vendor-shaped and blocks epic bbf1 AC3.
The outbound path should canonicalize the remote snapshot via the injected InboundMapper before comparison and emit vendor payloads only via the OutboundMapper at the emission boundary.
The InboundMapper output must gain canonical keys assignee_identity, reporter_identity, remote_parent_id, and labels so core can diff in local vocabulary without reading raw Jira keys.
The assignee resolver and _assignee_is_account_id sentinel must be re-homed onto OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee while preserving the exact 3-state payload contract and downstream dispatch behavior.

map_remote_to_local must tolerate a partial _BASELINE_FIELDS subset, emitting only canonical keys whose vendor source key is present, so an absent field means no baseline ancestor (per-field local-wins).

outbound_differ.py must contain no adapters.jira imports and none of the vendor payload key literals, enforced by an AST/denylist neutrality gate, with old-vs-new decision equivalence proven by a characterization suite.
